netz.kante.ansehen.vertrauen_regierung: A country that counts for something in the world is more inclined to trust its government.
welle_e1.eu.phase.eingefroren: Standstill since the Council conclusions of 26 June 2018: no chapter is opened or closed. Cooperation on security, energy and migration is no substitute for an accession perspective.
welle_e1.eu.zypern: Without movement on Cyprus, chapters {kapitel, list} stay blocked (conflict {konflikt} out of 100): implement the Ankara Protocol or defuse the conflict.
welle_e1.eu.rat2006: Frozen by the Council decision of 11 December 2006: only a treaty with Cyprus that opens the ports lifts the freeze.
welle_e1.eu.preis.grund: Brussels takes the package seriously only once EU alignment reaches {noetig} (now {wert}) or a reform pledge with the EU is in force.
welle_e1.eu.ankuendigung.zusage: Costs {pk} capital. The announcement works because a reform pledge with the EU is in force; nationalists read it as kowtowing, urban secular voters as a direction.
welle_e1.eu.frei.reform: What the pledge unlocks: the reform package in Brussels. Without it, EU alignment must reach {noetig}; it stands at {wert}.
welle_e1.eu.frei.reformLaeuft: What the pledge brings: it keeps the road to Brussels open; the reform package is already possible or announced.
welle_e1.eu.frei.visa: What the pledge unlocks: one criterion for visa-free travel ({erfuellt} of {alle} met today).
welle_e1.eu.echt: In reality 16 of 35 chapters are open. Of the ten chapters in the game, {n} are.
welle_e1.eu.preis.oder: or a reform pledge with the EU
welle_e1.eu.preis.bereit: The substance is there: Brussels opens the screening.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.text1: The Commission counts {offen} open and {zu} closed chapters; {blockiert} of {alle} are frozen. On visa-free travel, {visa} of {visaAlle} criteria are met.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.text2.eingefroren: Talks have been dormant since 2018. The reform package needs EU alignment at {noetig} (now {wert}) or a reform pledge. Ankara has to respond today; the foreign ministry has always done so on the day of the report.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.text2.bereit: Talks are dormant, but the substance for the reform package is there. Brussels reads Ankara's response to the report as a signal.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.text2.laeuft: Talks are under way. Ankara's response to the report sets the tone for the next chapters.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.warum: The Commission publishes its country report every autumn; in 2025 it came out on 4 November.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.opt.zusagen.label: Pledge a reform step
welle_e1.eu.bericht.opt.zusagen.beschr.m: Ankara pledges to deepen EU alignment within a year. Brussels and urban secular voters are pleased, nationalists grumble. A broken promise costs later.
Ankara pledges to advance judicial reform within a year. Brussels and urban secular voters are pleased, nationalists grumble. A broken promise costs later.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.zusage.m_eu_annaeher: The EU was promised closer alignment within a year
welle_e1.eu.bericht.zusage.m_justizrefor: The EU was promised a step on judicial reform within a year
Brussels takes note of the pledge. EU alignment has to rise within {tage} days.
Brussels takes note of the pledge. Judicial reform has to move within {tage} days.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.notiz.zusage: Reform pledge in response to the progress report
welle_e1.eu.bericht.opt.zurueck.label: Reject it as biased
welle_e1.eu.bericht.opt.zurueck.beschr: The foreign ministry calls the report biased, as in 2025. Nationalists and conservatives back you; trust in Brussels falls.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.opt.zurueck.ausgang: Ankara rejects the report as one-sided. The mood in Brussels cools.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.zeitung.fakt: The foreign ministry calls the progress report biased and unfounded.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.opt.schweigen.label: Stay silent
welle_e1.eu.bericht.opt.schweigen.beschr: No response. Brussels reads it as indifference; EU trust slips a little.
welle_e1.eu.bericht.standard: Ankara is silent on the report. Brussels reads it as indifference.
welle_e1.gipfel.opt.fernbleiben.label: Stay away
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.titel: NATO summit {jahr}: what will you commit to?
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.text1: Alliance leaders meet in the middle of the month. Since The Hague in 2025 the target is 5% of GDP by 2035, 3.5% of it for core defence. Türkiye stood at 2.33% in 2025.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.text2: Washington will judge Ankara by its pledge. US trust stands at {usa} out of 100.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.warum: The NATO summit comes every summer; in 2026 Ankara was the host.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.opt.zusage.label: Reaffirm the defence target
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.opt.zusage.beschr: You pledge to raise the defence budget within a year. Washington and the alliance appreciate it; a broken promise costs later.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.opt.zusage.ausgang: Türkiye reaffirms the target. The defence budget has to rise within {tage} days.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.zusage: NATO was promised a higher defence budget within a year
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.notiz: Defence target reaffirmed at the NATO summit
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.opt.bilateral.label: Meet the US president on the sidelines
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.opt.bilateral.besch: A working meeting with Washington, as in the country file: more trust and less friction, with no pledge to the alliance.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.opt.fernbleiben.bes: You send the foreign minister. Washington and the alliance are put out; Moscow and the nationalists read it as independence.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.opt.fernbleiben.aus: The president's seat at the table stays empty.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.fern.notiz: President stayed away from the NATO summit
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.standard: The foreign minister represents Türkiye; there is no pledge.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.zeitung.fakt: Türkiye pledges a higher defence budget at the summit.
welle_e1.gipfel.nato.zeitung.fernFakt: The foreign minister travels instead of the president; allies are irritated.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.titel: UN General Assembly {jahr}: your speech in New York
welle_e1.gipfel.un.text1: In the general debate, the world speaks. Since 2014 Ankara has repeated its slogan there: “The world is bigger than five.”
welle_e1.gipfel.un.text2: The sharpest dispute is with {gegner} (conflict {konflikt} out of 100). Türkiye's standing is {ansehen}.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.warum: The UN general debate opens every September.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.reform.label: Speech: “The world is bigger than five”
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.reform.beschr: You call for reform of the Security Council. Standing rises, nationalists and conservatives cheer, Washington dislikes it.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.reform.ausgang: The speech resonates across the Global South.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.anklage.label: Speech against {land}
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.anklage.beschr: You indict {land} before the world. At home nationalists and conservatives cheer; the dispute with {land} hardens.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.anklage.ausgang: The speech against {land} dominates the headlines.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.notiz: Indicted at the UN General Assembly
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.fernbleiben.besch: The UN ambassador speaks. The stage goes unused; standing slips.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.opt.fernbleiben.ausga: Türkiye speaks in New York only at ambassador level.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.standard: The foreign minister gives a speech few people hear.
welle_e1.gipfel.un.zeitung.fakt: In New York the president calls for reform of the Security Council.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.titel: Summit of Turkic States {jahr}: your agenda
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.text1: Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan sit at the table with Türkiye. The organisation's investment fund was agreed in March 2023.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.text2: Baku's trust stands at {aze}, Astana's at {kaz}. Northern Cyprus is an observer, yet in 2025 three members endorsed the UN resolutions on Cyprus.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.warum: The Turkic States summit meets every autumn; in 2025 in Gabala.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.korridor.label: Middle Corridor
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.korridor.beschr: Trade and transport across the Caspian to Central Asia. Members draw closer; Russia and China dislike it.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.korridor.ausgang: The summit agrees to expand the Middle Corridor.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.fonds.label: Pay into the investment fund
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.fonds.beschr: Ankara pays its share into the joint fund. It costs budget money, wins trust with every member and a little in exports.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.fonds.ausgang: The Turkic Investment Fund receives its contribution.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.zypern.label: Lobby for Northern Cyprus
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.zypern.beschr: You demand recognition of Northern Cyprus. Nationalists at home cheer; Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan do not follow, and Brussels is annoyed.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.zypern.ausgang: The final declaration stays vague on Northern Cyprus.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.fernbleiben.besc: You stay away. Members feel snubbed.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.opt.fernbleiben.ausg: Without the president the summit ends without results.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.standard: The foreign minister goes; members had expected more.
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.zeitung.titel: Türkiye pays into the Turkic States fund
welle_e1.gipfel.ots.zeitung.fakt: At the summit Ankara commits its share of the investment fund.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.titel: G20 summit {jahr}: what will you use the trip for?
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.text1: The largest economies meet; Türkiye has been a member since 1999 and hosted the summit in Antalya in 2015.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.text2: Trade with the EU stands at {eu} out of 100, standing at {ansehen}. Investors are watching Ankara.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.warum: The G20 summit meets every late autumn.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.investoren.label: Meet investors on the sidelines
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.investoren.besch: You court funds and corporations. More foreign capital, calmer markets.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.investoren.ausga: The talks with investors go well.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.handel.label: Trade talks with the EU
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.handel.beschr: Tariffs and supply chains with the largest trading partner. More trade and a little in exports.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.handel.ausgang: Brussels and Ankara agree on a working group on trade.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.notiz: Trade talks on the sidelines of the G20
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.fernbleiben.besc: You stay away. Standing slips; investors take note.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.opt.fernbleiben.ausg: Türkiye is barely visible among the big players.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.standard: The finance minister represents Türkiye, without much impact.
welle_e1.gipfel.g20.zeitung.fakt: On the sidelines of the G20 the president meets funds and corporations.
welle_e1.verm.text1: {a|anfang} and {b} are ready to talk: ripeness {reif} out of 100, the chance of a deal is {aussicht}%.
welle_e1.verm.text2: Trust in Ankara: {a} {vA}, {b} {vB}. On the table would be: {paket}.
welle_e1.verm.warum: A conflict is ripe when the chance exceeds {ab}%; today {aussicht}%. The model is the Istanbul rounds of 2022 and 2025.
welle_e1.verm.opt.einladen.label: Istanbul invites
welle_e1.verm.opt.einladen.beschr: Ankara provides venue and format. After {tage} days the delegations sit down; if the round succeeds, standing and trust grow, otherwise it costs face.
welle_e1.verm.opt.gesandter.label: Send an envoy
welle_e1.verm.opt.gesandter.beschr: Discreet channels to both sides. Ripeness grows and both trust Ankara a little more; the table is not set yet.
welle_e1.verm.opt.abwarten.label: Wait
welle_e1.verm.opt.abwarten.beschr: Others host the talks. Both sides remember that Ankara declined; standing slips a little.
welle_e1.verm.eingeladen: Istanbul invites: the delegations in the {namen} conflict arrive in {tage} days.
welle_e1.verm.grund.eingeladen: The delegations are invited; the round starts in {tage} days.
welle_e1.verm.runde.aussicht: The chance on the day of the round was {aussicht}%.
welle_e1.verm.zeitung.fakt: Ankara offers to host talks in the {konflikt} conflict.
